landing.heroDesc: AI-Powered E-Mandi bridges Indian tomato farmers directly with wholesale buyers. Snap a photo of your harvest to grade produce, generate verifiable digital certificates, and trade with zero middlemen cuts.
landing.howItWorksDesc: Transforming traditional APMC mandi trade into a verifiable digital ecosystem.
landing.step1Desc: Farmer captures a harvest photo directly on mobile. Our YOLO neural network instantly detects individual tomatoes, identifies rotten spots, and computes standard defect percentages.
landing.step2Desc: A tamper-evident Digital Quality Certificate is minted with a unique ID and QR code. The verified grade is locked by backend logic, preventing misrepresentation and boosting buyer trust.
landing.step3Desc: List the lot in the wholesale marketplace. Buyers place orders with atomic inventory reservation to avoid overselling. Farmer accepts, dispatches, and gets paid fair rates.
landing.step3Footer: Transparent orders with real-time status timelines
landing.metricsDesc: Built mobile-first for outdoor mandi environments, low-bandwidth village networks, and regional language preferences.
landing.farmerAdv1Desc: No more arbitrary price cuts by local middlemen claiming spoilage. AI inspection gives you hard data.
landing.farmerAdv2Desc: Connect with institutional buyers, hotel chains, and retail wholesalers across Maharashtra and Gujarat.
landing.farmerAdv3Desc: Full support for Marathi, Hindi, and English with outdoor-readable high-contrast typography.
landing.buyerWhyTitle: Why Wholesale Buyers Rely on Us
landing.buyerAdv1Desc: Review defect rates and produce size breakdowns before placing purchase commitments.
landing.buyerAdv2Desc: When you place an order, inventory is reserved atomically to eliminate out-of-stock race conditions.
landing.buyerAdv3Desc: Scan produce batch certificates on dispatch arrival for instant authenticity validation.
